achievements.name: Greatest of Great Deliverers
achievements.description: Obtained all Death Stranding achievements.

achievements.name: BBs: A Bridge Between This World and the One Beyond
Sixty Deaths and Sixty Births in a Day
She's waiting for you on the Beach.
Everyday Delivery
achievements.description: Complete a standard order.

achievements.name: Deliveries Done
achievements.description: Complete 36 standard orders.

achievements.name: Birth of a Legend
achievements.description: Complete at least 10 unique premium deliveries in each order category with an evaluation of "Legend," "Legend of Legends," or "Legend of Legends of Legends."

achievements.name: Growth of a Legend
achievements.description: Complete at least 20 unique premium deliveries in each order category with an evaluation of "Legend of Legends" or "Legend of Legends of Legends."

achievements.name: A Helping Hand
achievements.description: Issue your first supply request.

achievements.name: The Automation Revolution
achievements.description: Complete a standard order with a delivery bot.

achievements.name: Apprentice Builder
achievements.description: Complete your first structure (signs, ladders, and climbing anchors also count.)

achievements.name: Master Builder
achievements.description: Complete at least one of every type of structure (including signs, ladders, and climbing anchors.)

achievements.name: A New Day for the UCA
Well Connected
achievements.description: Reach connection level three with a facility.

achievements.name: Good Samaritan
achievements.description: Deliver your first piece of lost cargo.

achievements.name: Giver of Gifts
achievements.description: Make your first donation of weapons, equipment, etc.

achievements.name: The Post Guides the Present
achievements.description: Read 100 mails.

achievements.name: The Past Guides the Present
achievements.description: Read 100 interviews.

achievements.name: Pathfinder
achievements.description: Help porters through a MULE or terrorist area for the first time.

achievements.name: Childminder
achievements.description: Reach maximum connection level with BB.

achievements.name: A Baby Blessing
achievements.description: Get a Like from BB.

achievements.name: Prominent Porter
achievements.description: Reach Grade 10 in any delivery evaluation category.

achievements.name: Catcher Crusher
achievements.description: Defeat a Catcher.

achievements.name: Snooze 'n' Soothe
achievements.description: Heal by sleeping for the first time.

achievements.name: Boots Are a Porter's Best Friend
achievements.description: Change footwear for the first time.

achievements.name: Hooked on Delivering!?
achievements.description: Deliver 700 items of cargo.

achievements.name: Pumped Porter
achievements.description: Deliver 3,000 kg of cargo.

achievements.name: Well-Traveled
achievements.description: Travel 80 km and complete an order.

achievements.name: Rest In Pieces
achievements.description: In a BT area, cut an umbilical cord for the first time without the BT noticing.

achievements.name: Sleep Tight, Little BB
achievements.description: Soothe a crying BB and stop the crying for the first time.

achievements.name: A Shout in the Dark
achievements.description: Send a shout out and have it returned for the first time.

achievements.name: Public Service Porter
achievements.description: Dispose of chiralium-contaminated cargo in the crater lake for the first time.

achievements.name: Trail-Blazer
achievements.description: Upgrade all types of structure to the maximum level.

achievements.name: All Roads Lead to the UCA
achievements.description: Complete your first road.

achievements.name: Building Bridges
achievements.description: Reach Bridge Link Grade 1.

achievements.name: Homo Faber
achievements.description: Fabricate all available weapons and equipment.
